parts.text: How many days of paid bereavement leave am I entitled to for an immediate family member?
Employees are entitled to up to 5 paid bereavement leave days for an immediate family member (spouse, partner, child, parent) and up to 2 paid days for an extended relative. [HR-POL-LEAVE-004#3.2]
